comparison.objective: Use balance feedback and a pipette to correct an under- or overfilled liquid dose to 10.000 g; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Aspiration/dispensing, pressure control and iterative mass correction versus hex-key alignment, collar rotation, tightening and iterative dynamic-response correction.
comparison.success_condition: Body requires 10.000 ±0.050 g and pipette disposal, with failure if the receiving beaker moves >5 mm; no complete spec version is present. Candidate requires two safe carriage cycles and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both iteratively correct based on measurement, but the physical abilities and controlled processes—liquid metering versus impact damping—are meaningfully different.
